Usage: headroom headless mint <account> [flags]

Mint a long-lived token for one account through claude setup-token.

Mints a long-lived token for one account through Claude Code's own claude setup-token,
approved in the Chrome profile matched to the account — or, over ssh, at the printed URL
with the code pasted back — and stores it in a file only you can read. It needs a terminal:
the vendor asks for the approval there, and waits up to ten minutes for it.

Arguments:
  <account>        The account to mint for; its dir must be logged in to it.

Inherited flags:
  -h, --help       Show context-sensitive help.
      --version    Print the build this binary is — its commit and the commit's time — and exit.

Exit codes:
  0    success
  1    failed
  2    invalid arguments, nothing was run; for check, an assertion it could not test (INCONCLUSIVE)
  3    headless place refused: every account it could take is near a limit or excluded; login start,
       finish or cancel refused, nothing spent or sent: the document's reason says why
